headline: Gulf Cryo to start production at new Abu Dhabi carbon-capture plant within weeks
summary: UAE industrial-gases group Gulf Cryo said its new carbon-capture/CO2 facility in Abu Dhabi will begin production within weeks, part of a push to nearly double regional CO2 output (toward ~1,300 tonnes/day across the GCC by end-2026) and cut reliance on imported recovered CO2. A merchant-market CCU/capture start-up, not geological storage.
co2crc_note: Gulf-region merchant CO2/CCU capacity growth is tangential to CO2CRC's geological-storage focus but a marker of MENA capture activity.
extractor_note: Imminent plant start-up (not yet operational); date and location from Google-Alerts sampler metadata, WebFetch blocked so unverified. Abu Dhabi plant aligns with Gulf Cryo's stated second UAE CCU facility targeted for end-2026.

headline: California court rules Kern County approval of Carbon TerraVault breached CEQA, forcing a temporary shutdown
summary: A California Superior Court judge ruled that Kern County's approval of Carbon TerraVault I - the first operational CCS project in the US (first CO2 injection at Elk Hills 26R in May 2026) - violated the California Environmental Quality Act, requiring the project to temporarily halt pending a corrected environmental review. Operator California Resources can appeal.
co2crc_note: A CEQA-driven forced shutdown of the first operational US CCS project is a salient social-licence and permitting-risk precedent for Australian storage approvals.
extractor_note: Court ruling / negative event direction (project forced to temporarily halt). Single-source (Courthouse News); pub_date inferred from 'ruled Tuesday' (3 Nov US = 4 Nov Melbourne, in-window); WebFetch blocked so unverified. Distinct NEW development vs the 4 Nov Carbon TerraVault Q3 permit/MOU item.
